disclosure: Exploratory continuation after original654test results were already known. Five-fold selection uses only official795training images and scene IDs; no official test metric is consulted by the CV phase.

selection_rule.primary: minimum equal-image mean out-of-fold AbsRel across all795trainimages
selection_rule.ties: within1e-12 AbsRel, lower RMSE then higher delta1 then method name
selection_rule.promotion: winner must be median, or its scene-bootstrap gain over median has positive98.333333%CI lower bound (Bonferroni across3nonmedian alternatives)
selection_rule.secondary: RMSE,delta1,fold winners,per-scene variation,tail error reported; not used to override primary except exact ties
selection_rule.reference: original frozen median remains available; a selected follow-up artifact is separate
selection_rule.uncertainty: conditional on frozen out-of-fold predictions; bootstrap does not refit fold scalars

fold_construction: shuffle sorted unique scene IDs with default_rng(seed), split into5equal scene-count chunks
